description: Layer 4 - Advanced fixes: Database migration tracking system and Playwright E2E test scaffold
steps: Create apps/backend/app/db/migrations/runner.py: A migration runner that (a) connects to a 'schema_versions' collection in MongoDB, (b) has a function check_schema_version() that reads the current version from schema_versions, (c) has a function apply_migration(version, description, up_fn) that runs the migration function and records it, (d) has a function get_applied_migrations() that returns all applied versions. Use Motor directly (not Beanie) since this runs at startup before Beanie init.

Create apps/backend/app/db/migrations/versions/v001_initial_indexes.py as a sample migration that creates the indexes (can delegate to the existing create_indexes function or be a no-op placeholder documenting what indexes exist).

In apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py, after init_beanie and create_indexes, add a call to run pending migrations from the migration runner. Import and call a check_and_apply_migrations() function. Add appropriate error handling and logging.
Create apps/frontend/playwright.config.ts with a basic Playwright configuration. Set baseURL to http://localhost:5173 (Vite dev default), use chromium project, set headless mode.
Create apps/frontend/e2e/login.spec.ts: Test login flow. Use page.route() to mock the backend /auth/login and /users/me endpoints. Verify that after login the user sees their profile menu.
Create apps/frontend/e2e/chat.spec.ts: Test chat send/receive. Mock the /api/v1/chat/stream endpoint to return SSE events. Verify that a message appears in the chat UI.
Create apps/frontend/e2e/navigation.spec.ts: Test navigation between pages. Navigate to /, /login, /chat and verify each page renders without errors.
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/app/db/migrations/runner.py exists with check_schema_version, apply_migration, get_applied_migrations functions
apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py calls migration runner after beanie init
apps/frontend/playwright.config.ts exists with valid Playwright configuration
apps/frontend/e2e/ directory has login.spec.ts, chat.spec.ts, navigation.spec.ts
verification: python -c "import apps.backend.app.db.migrations.runner" (syntax check from project root with PYTHONPATH)
test -f apps/frontend/e2e/login.spec.ts && test -f apps/frontend/e2e/chat.spec.ts && test -f apps/frontend/e2e/navigation.spec.ts
